translation: So I offered them some tea.

Everyone in the computer society was really
pleased…
Mikuru!
Y-yes?
Great job!
Huh…?

First, you use that tender smile of yours to
get in close and lower their defenses…

And then, that lets you creep in and
gradually destroy them from the inside…

With those methods, you can get away without
having to needlessly fight on the frontlines.

"As long as l can be friends with Mikuru…”
I'm sure that satisfies them, right, Mikuru?
H-huhhh?!

It's a strategy that makes the very best
use…
…of our ultimate moe character, Mikuru!!
I wasn't really trying to d—

That's a pretty high-level strategy for
someone like you.
I'm glad to see that my training has paid off!

S-Suzumiya, I was only trying to serve them
tea…
It's fine, you don't have to be so modest.

I always knew you had it in you, Mikuru. You
have a natural talent for this stuff!
T-talent?

How should I put it…? You're basically like an
enchantress!
W-what do you mean by that?!

You're just so small and cute—it makes
people want to protect you!
That's the vibe you give off, right?

That kind of thing basically lets you enchant
men and control them.

S-Suzumiya, just what kind of impression do
you have of me?!
Please don't think of me like that!

What are you crying about? You should be
honored.

It would be more of a sin not to take
advantage of your god-given charm.
Eeeek—
Well, anyways…

Apart from Mikuru using her charm on the
computer society members…

Ehhhh?! Please don't change the story as
you see fit!

I got it! Maybe we can start bringing the
other clubs under our control too?
What do you think, Mikuru?

We should definitely start with the baseball
club, right?
I'm telling you I can't do that!!
Just kidding.
